3 Kitchen Scale Buying Mistakes to Avoid

Skipping the tare function entirely: Choose a scale with tare so container weight doesn't skew your measurements. Overlooking the maximum weight capacity: Match capacity to your largest typical ingredients so it won't max out mid-recipe.
